og.title: The Decoherence Trap: When AI slop drowns out the signal in an endless sea of noise
og.description: Of all the forms of tech debt, decoherence is the worst. It compounds exponentially with a system's rate of change, and AI is now producing it faster than ever, leading us deeper and deeper into the abyss...
